entries.0cb43285f341d7d6: Its strength lies in the technology it has accumulated since its founding in 1937, from processing gears and shafts to becoming a specialist manufacturer of drivetrain products. Cumulative production of four-wheel drive transfers reached 6,000,000 units in December 2006, and the company has expanded its drivetrain product range, including power shift transmissions for large tractors and reduction gears for e-Axles in electric vehicles. It has production bases in Japan, the United States, Indonesia and Thailand, and maintains a structure that can respond to customers’ overseas production.

entries.b2c6c457c214097b: Since its founding in 1937, the company has pursued management activities aimed at becoming a competitive, proposal-oriented enterprise, providing optimal products with customer-first thinking. Under its founding spirit of “Always aim higher than today,” the company aims to create “attractive products” as a specialist manufacturer of drivetrain products and to become a partner that exceeds customers’ expectations, and it sets its corporate philosophy, “Based on respect for people, we will contribute to the happiness of people through continuous innovation,” as the basis of its management. As for its medium- to long-term management strategy, the company states that, to achieve sustainable growth and medium-term enhancement of corporate value, it will further realize Vision2030, “Contributing to society through monozukuri-based kotozukuri,” and continue to work on (1) increasing competitiveness and expanding existing business areas, (2) creating new businesses, and (3) strengthening its corporate foundation. Through effective use of existing assets and optimal process design suited to the characteristics of its production sites, along with advancing the sophistication of proposal-based business and integrating deepening of existing technologies with new ideas, the company states it will promote diversification of its business portfolio and build a medium- to long-term growth foundation. In addition, through strengthening its corporate foundation, including responses to carbon neutrality, enhancement of human capital and promotion of digitalization, the company aims to establish a business operating structure resilient to changes in the environment.
